trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. It unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so never chase it directly: work the roadmap stages in order and let this one close the list. If everything else shows as earned and it has not popped, earn any single trophy again or restart the game to nudge it through.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It plays out as part of the game's introduction, so simply play through the start of the story and it unlocks as the mission ends. Nothing optional is involved.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1. Keep following the story markers after Gone Fishing and the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. Story progress only — no side content is required.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2. The chapter opens as soon as Chapter 1 is done; play its story missions through to the end and the trophy unlocks with the chapter.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3. Follow the story markers as the chapter unfolds; the trophy pops when the last Chapter 3 mission ends.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the endgame. Play the story through and the trophy unlocks as the chapter closes.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission, which becomes available after Chapter 4. Before you start the finale, clear the missable-flagged trophies in this guide (Catch Me If You Can above all), in case the ending limits free roam afterwards. Finish the story and the gold is yours.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is part of the main storyline, so it unlocks simply by playing through the campaign; no optional work is needed.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a main story mission. Play the story until the heist is offered, work through its setup and its finale, and the trophy pops at mission complete.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It sits on the main storyline, so it unlocks as you play the campaign in order.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the campaign until the mission is offered and finish it; the trophy unlocks at mission complete.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. While you are at the airport for this mission, also do Catch Me If You Can (below in this guide): the unscheduled departure is far easier to arrange during the mission than after it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is part of the main storyline; finish the mission and the trophy unlocks at its end.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion tracker. That means the full story plus the tracked side content — the strands, activities, collectibles and challenges this guide lists stage by stage. Leave it late: once the other roadmap stages are done, use the in-game 100% checklist to find whatever small piece is still missing.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the stunt jumps and stunt events spread across Leonida. Work them region by region alongside The Goodtime State so travel is never wasted, and keep a fast, sturdy vehicle handy for the jumps. PSN tracks the running total, and the counter beside this trophy in the tracker mirrors it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types at least once — races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation and the rest. One attempt at each is enough; you do not need to win. Do it early as a tour: it also shows you which activities the count trophies in this guide will ask much more of.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon's challenge layout, then replay it until the gold score or time is beaten. Medals are kept per challenge, so you can gold them in any order and across several sessions — the counter beside this trophy tracks how many are done.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. A start is not enough — the trophy needs a win at each location. If one course keeps costing you time, fly it in practice attempts until the line is familiar, then go for the win.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — twenty separate events, not the same race twenty times. Work through the race list on the map, and if one event keeps beating you, tune or swap your vehicle instead of repeating losses; each event only counts once.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the fishing challenge with Cal when it is offered and land the better catch under its rules. If you lose, it can be retried — learn where the bigger fish bite at that spot before trying again.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet in the world and play a game through to its end — win or lose, finishing a full game is what the trophy asks for.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's strand. Work through every mission Andy offers as they appear on the map; the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Finishing a strand like this also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Take each of Kenton's missions as they appear and play the strand to its end; the trophy unlocks with his last mission, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Follow Billy's missions on the map through to the last one; the trophy pops at its end, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is one character's chain of missions — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others — and a strand completes at that character's final mission. The strand-final trophies in this guide are your progress markers; the counter beside this one totals them.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Play Randy's missions as they appear on the map until the strand ends; the trophy unlocks with the last one, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Work through Tyrone's missions in order as they appear; the trophy pops at the end of the last one, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots sit at scenic points around the state; visit each one and use the meditation prompt when you get there. They are quick stops — sweep them region by region while exploring for The Goodtime State.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunting request, track the animal it names in the habitat it points you to, and bring it down. Unique animals appear at set places, so search the area the request names rather than wandering the whole map.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in themed sets, and a set only counts when every card in it has been found. Pick the three shortest sets first and sweep them area by area; the in-game collection screen shows exactly which cards a set still needs.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Wherever the WAiNK prompt appears in the world, use it once — each new location adds one to the total PSN tracks. Make it a habit while exploring and the hundred will be done long before the map is finished.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges are the short tracked tasks the game lists as you play, and they accumulate from ordinary driving, combat and activity play. Check the challenge list late in your run and mop up whichever ones are closest to done.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape. Raise your wanted level to four stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Open ground outside the city makes the escape half far easier than downtown streets.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without your wanted level dropping away in between. Hit one shop, go straight to the next while the heat is still on, then a third — if the wanted level fully clears between shops, the chain restarts. Pick three nearby shops before you begin.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — a vehicle counts when you first get in and drive it. Swap cars often instead of living in one favourite, and grab anything parked that you have not driven before. The count climbs fastest in traffic-dense districts.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with at least five enemies in reach, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A crowded shootout during a story mission is the natural place to try it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport outside the scripted route. The chance comes during the VCIA Takedown mission: instead of following the planned exit, take a plane or vehicle out on your own. Flagged missable: if you finish that mission without doing it, and chapter replay does not cover it, it is gone for the run — do it the first time you are there.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the game's tanks. When a Rhino is fielded against you, disable or destroy it rather than running: heavy weapons and sustained fire do the work. Keep solid cover between you and its cannon while you wear it down.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quietly, keep staff and cameras from raising the alarm, and be out before anyone notices. If an attempt turns loud, leave it and try another store fresh — a detected robbery does not count.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Crack the vault, take the money, and lose the heat afterwards — a robbery only counts once you have escaped. Work through different banks until five clean getaways are logged.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks move cash around the state — stop one, open it up, take the money, and break away from the response. Waiting until the truck is on a quiet stretch of road makes the getaway much simpler.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. An area counts once you have visited it, and the map fills in as you travel. Sweep the state region by region — the meditation spots, cards and WAiNK locations in this guide will carry you through most areas on the way.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations; hit at least one of each gang's and escape. Work the map gang by gang so you never repeat one gang while another is still untouched.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot, and take in the view. A quiet one: it is earned simply by being in the right place and using the prompt when it appears.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car out through the showroom glass. The moment reads as a set piece tied to a specific scene, so when a scene puts you in a car inside a showroom, drive out through the window rather than the door. Flagged missable because that scene may not repeat.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and follow through. Visit the alley, start a game of bowling, and bowl your frames — the trophy is for taking part at that alley and seeing the game through.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — a shared scene with your partner that plays to a crowd. The official description names no place, so treat any story scene that puts the partnership on show as the chance: do not rush past partnership scenes, and if a prompt to perform or pose together appears, take it. Flagged missable until the exact moment is pinned down.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a running count to 500. Dialogue and story choices across the whole game all add to it, so the total grows on its own through a full playthrough. If it is still short at the end, side content with choices is where the rest are earned.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then attempt it again and succeed. The official description does not name the event, so whenever a story or activity attempt fails, retry it instead of moving on; the trophy is tied to one such retry. Flagged missable until the exact event is known.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd encounters off the beaten path — when something in the world looks out of place, stop and watch it play out instead of driving past. Exploring every area for The Goodtime State is the surest way to cross paths with it.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — strike a target with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Ride or drive past at speed and swing as you pass; the hit has to land while you are moving.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade) and PSNProfiles (listing). Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts instead of sitting on them, and the laundered total PSN tracks will climb. The big scores late in the story move this fastest.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, vehicles, weapons and services all count toward the one total. It comes naturally across a full run; if you are short near the end, vehicle and property shops are the fastest way to spend.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings around Leonida; save toward them as your money grows and buy each one as it becomes affordable. Owning all eight is what counts — you do not need to fill them.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want to keep, register it in the app there and then; ten registrations complete the trophy. Registering as you go is far easier than saving it all for the end.
trophies.sources: Sources: official PS5 trophy list on Exophase (name, description, grade); the tracked target as listed by PSNProfiles. Guide text: our own, written from the official description.
